threat_model.direct_injection: User text attempts to override system/developer instructions or policy.
threat_model.indirect_injection: Retrieved documents, catalog content, or tool output contains instructions aimed at the model.
threat_model.rag_poisoning: Knowledge content attempts to manipulate retrieval or answer behavior instead of acting as evidence.
threat_model.system_prompt_extraction: User attempts to reveal hidden system/developer prompts or internal chain-of-thought.
threat_model.tool_abuse: User or retrieved content attempts to force unauthorized, dangerous, or unrelated tool calls.
threat_model.authorization_bypass: Prompt text tries to impersonate another user, role, customer_id, or admin privilege.
threat_model.data_exfiltration: Prompt text asks for secrets, tokens, API keys, private customer data, or bulk internal data.
